detailZh:
“是什么让这个车队变得特别呢？那就是每个人为了同一个目标而团结一致，每天能与这样一群有才华且投入的团队一起工作，我感到非常荣幸。” 💙
#F1 || #RedBullRacing
detailEn:
🗣️ “What makes this Team special is the way everyone comes together in pursuit of the same goal, and I feel privileged to work alongside such a talented and committed group every day.” 💙
#F1 || #RedBullRacing
